# A night cloud: three flattened faceted puffs side by side, 2.6 m long, unlit slate (it
# drifts across the sky in front of the moon). Facing the camera like the moon. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Cloud --base-color 0.196 0.325 0.373 --no-slot --emission 0.196 0.325 0.373
add mesh ico-sphere --name P0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location -0.8 0 0
scale 1.4 0.3 0.62
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name P1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.62 --location 0.1 0 0.12
scale 1.4 0.3 0.75
apply --scale
add mesh ico-sphere --name P2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.45 --location 0.95 0 -0.02
scale 1.4 0.3 0.6
apply --scale
select P0 P1 P2
active P1
join
rename P1 Cloud
material assign Cloud
set rotation -42 0 0
apply --rotation
shade flat
export cloud.glb
